statement_language.activity: Economic activity is expanding at a solid pace. Uncertainty remains elevated owing, in part, to geopolitical developments; domestic spending has been resilient. Productivity growth is strong and capital investment is robust.
statement_language.labor: Job gains have kept pace with the workforce, and the unemployment rate has changed little.
statement_language.inflation: Inflation remains elevated. Today's policy action will support a timelier return to the Committee's 2 percent goal.

press_conference_quotes.quote: This summer's inflation readings do not tell me that underlying trends have meaningfully improved.
press_conference_quotes.speaker: Chair Kevin Warsh
press_conference_quotes.context: on why the Fed hiked despite growth resilience

press_conference_quotes.quote: We cannot affect any individual price, but what we can do and will do is ensure that any change in relative prices don't broaden out, don't have second and third order effects on the economy.
press_conference_quotes.speaker: Chair Kevin Warsh
press_conference_quotes.context: citing oil and groceries as examples of relative-price moves the Fed will not chase, but guarding against broadening

press_conference_quotes.quote: I would say these things tend to be overdetermined. This is a complicated set of things that are affecting the most important asset anywhere in the world, the 10-year Treasury.
press_conference_quotes.speaker: Chair Kevin Warsh
press_conference_quotes.context: on drivers of the 10-year Treasury yield

press_conference_quotes.quote: Those who are least well off have the most to gain from a durable expansion, a solid labor market, and stable prices.

press_conference_quotes.context: on distributional case for the hike
